evidence_gaps: evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with generated_epoch 0 and no generation timestamp.
No fresh-within-two-hours opportunity, quote, simulation, broadcast, confirmation or wallet-delta records.
No per-strategy money-weighted net P&L after all fees, slippage, impact and failed-attempt costs.
No Solana contemporaneous entry/exit quote pairs, sellability confirmations, priority/Jito payments, rent lifecycle or landing-rate distribution.
No EVM effective gas-paid, builder-payment, revert-cost, inclusion-latency or quote-to-fill deterioration distribution by chain.
No outcome taxonomy separating STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
No out-of-sample or regime-stratified results, drawdown, tail-loss, capital utilization or confidence intervals.

Before any promotion, require fresh reconciled runtime exports covering all attempts, chain-specific costs, exact quote ages, simulations, confirmations, wallet deltas, failure causes and held-out money-weighted performance.

proposals.downside_risk: More fields and stricter completeness rules will reduce apparent sample size and delay conclusions.

evidence.detail: Window schema records fees and slippage but has no explicit price-impact, gas/priority, rent, failed-attempt cost, notional or capital-time fields.
Default net profit is gross profit minus gross loss, fees and slippage only.
Eight trades across three windows can become a promotion candidate based on aggregate net and profit factor.
Solana receipts separately expose network fee, priority fee, Jito tip, rent paid/reclaimed, wallet delta and execution P&L.

proposals.expected_effect: Promotion decisions would use reconciled, chain-specific, money-weighted net outcomes and include the economic cost of failed submissions.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 completed opportunities per chain, 20 realised round trips per chain, three independent market regimes and 14 days, with all attempted executions represented.
proposals.rationale: The review objective is durable money-weighted net P&L. Aggregating heterogeneous costs into optional caller-supplied net values permits optimistic or incomparable evaluations and does not measure return on deployed capital.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay SHADOW windows with per-attempt notional and timestamp. For EVM deduct realised gas, priority fee, builder payment, slippage and impact; for Solana deduct network fee, priority/Jito tip, platform fee, non-refunded rent and failed-attempt costs while crediting confirmed rent reclamation. Stop and mark the window unusable if wallet-delta reconciliation is absent or cost coverage is below 95%. Require positive money-weighted net P&L and profit factor above 1.10 in each chain and in held-out windows.

proposals.downside_risk: Extra quoting increases RPC/API load, and conservative latency reserves may produce few eligible observations.

evidence.detail: Solana leader-event adaptation deliberately sets gross edge, costs, liquidity and sellability to zero because no contemporaneous executable quote is available.
Common eligibility requires positive net edge plus liquidity, sellability and quote freshness.
Execution validation already measures combined quoted impact and slippage and rejects excessive routes.

proposals.expected_effect: Solana strategies will abstain unless a sellable round trip has positive executable edge, while separating market decay from RPC, simulation, signing and landing failures.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 quoted signals, 50 fully sellable delayed round-trip observations, 14 days and coverage across low and high congestion periods.
proposals.rationale: Leader-copy observations alone cannot establish forward executable edge. Solana needs a SHADOW adapter using contemporaneous round-trip quotes and its own fee, priority/tip, rent and failure economics.
proposals.shadow_test: For every eligible leader or market signal, capture timestamped entry and immediate exit quotes at intended size, quote age, price impact, slippage floor, base fee, priority/Jito tip, platform fee, token-account rent exposure and latency reserve. Compare predicted net edge with a no-broadcast delayed re-quote. Fail the hypothesis if median realised-equivalent net edge is non-positive, sellability cannot be reconfirmed, or quote/simulation infrastructure failure exceeds 5%.

proposals.downside_risk: Classification errors could misattribute mixed failures such as latency-driven reverts.

evidence.detail: Execution failures are stored only as an aggregate count.
Two execution failures pause a strategy, but failure causes and incurred costs are not differentiated.
EVM simulation explicitly distinguishes preparation, quote-edge, gas-estimation and preflight failures.
Solana economic guards emit structured rejection reasons and details.

proposals.expected_effect: Lifecycle decisions can separately rework negative-edge strategies and quarantine unreliable execution paths without forgiving fees lost on failed transactions.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 opportunities and 50 execution attempts per chain, including at least 20 failure or rejection events where available.
proposals.rationale: STRATEGY/MARKET loss means a successfully executable thesis produced negative net P&L or its edge decayed. EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure means quote, RPC, simulation, signing, broadcast, landing or reconciliation failed. Combining them can replace a sound hypothesis for an infrastructure defect or hide costly failed attempts.
proposals.shadow_test: Classify every opportunity into MARKET_NO_EDGE, STRATEGY_LOSS, QUOTE_FAILURE, SIMULATION_FAILURE, RPC_FAILURE, SIGNING_FAILURE, BROADCAST_FAILURE, LANDING_FAILURE or RECONCILIATION_FAILURE, retaining costs and quote timestamps. Manually audit a stratified 50-event sample. Stop promotion evaluation if classification agreement is below 90% or more than 2% of attempts remain unclassified.

proposals.downside_risk: Valid but rare arbitrage may remain unpromoted for a long period.

evidence.detail: CANARY advances after three trades and can become ACTIVE after eight trades.
The lane is restricted to existing exact EVM routes and retains executor safeguards.
EVM cycle simulation reserves 30% above estimated gas using current fee fields.
EVM executable eligibility requires exact quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability and route approval.

proposals.expected_effect: Longer out-of-sample SHADOW evidence will reduce small-sample promotion risk without forcing trades.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 executable observations, 30 completed SHADOW cycles, 30 days and three distinct gas-volatility regimes per EVM chain.
proposals.rationale: The execution gates are directionally strong, but three and eight outcomes cannot demonstrate durable money-weighted performance across fee and liquidity regimes.
proposals.shadow_test: Run exact-route SHADOW re-quotes at intended size and score realised-equivalent net after AMM fees embedded in output, gas at effective paid price, priority/builder costs, impact, slippage and failed-attempt costs. Stop if cumulative money-weighted net is non-positive, lower confidence bound on mean net edge crosses zero, or execution failure rate exceeds 3%.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any existing strategy based on repository safeguards alone.
rejected_ideas.reason: Architecture is not runtime profitability evidence, and the supplied evidence explicitly lacks current forensics.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax edge, liquidity, sellability, impact or simulation gates.
rejected_ideas.reason: This would manufacture exposure without evidence of positive executable edge and could reduce net P&L.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat a high historical leader-wallet win ratio as Solana edge.
rejected_ideas.reason: The Solana adapter correctly identifies that leader events lack a current executable future-return quote; win count is not money-weighted net evidence.

rejected_ideas.idea: Apply one fixed cost threshold across Solana and EVM.
rejected_ideas.reason: Solana priority/Jito tips, rent and landing behavior differ materially from EVM gas, priority/builder payments and revert economics.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository contains fail-closed quote, liquidity, sellability and simulation controls, with materially different Solana and EVM execution economics. However, Strategy Lab accounting can label results promotion candidates without first-class gas, priority/tip, price-impact, rent, failed-attempt and capital-weighted fields. Solana strategy features intentionally lack executable edge. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness claim is supportable without fresh runtime forensics.
